test_title: PYST 14: SSC MTS 2023 - English (Held On: 08 Sept, 2023 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blanks. (Ø = No article)

____ doctor suggested doing some eye exercises and wearing ____ pair of powered glasses.
solution:
The correct answer is** Option 4 **i.e.** The; a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **"The"** is used before "**doctor**" to refer to a specific doctor that has already been mentioned or is known in the context.
 
• **"A" **is used before **"pair of powered glasses**" because it introduces a singular, non-specific item for the first time.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is- **The; a.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: A; a: **"A" can be used before "doctor" if this is the first time the doctor is mentioned, but "The" is more correct in this context if the doctor has been mentioned before or is specific.
 
• **Option 2: Ø; a:** Without an article before "doctor," the sentence is grammatically incorrect because "doctor" needs an article.
 
• **Option 3: A; Ø:** The absence of "a" before "pair of powered glasses" makes the sentence incorrect.
